basrah-oil-terminal.name: Al-Basra Oil Terminal
basrah-oil-terminal.why: Atlas point 29.68 N, 48.80 E, row no. 48392 Al-Basra Oil Terminal at 29.68 N, 48.82 E. The row's main name is the atlas port's name in another spelling (its alternate name is Mina Al Bakr Terminal); the next row of the country, Khawr Al Amaya, is a separate terminal.

fujairah.name: Al Fujayrah
fujairah.why: Atlas point 25.12 N, 56.36 E, row no. 48262 Al Fujayrah at 25.17 N, 56.37 E. The names are two spellings of Fujairah (the row's alternate name is Fujayrah Harbor) and the next row of the country, Khawr Fakkan, is another port; the page the atlas cites is about the Fujairah oil terminal and the entry is the harbour.

loop.name: Loop Terminal
loop.why: Atlas point 28.89 N, 90.03 W, row no. 8980 Loop Terminal at 28.88 N, 90.02 W. The atlas port is the Louisiana Offshore Oil Port (LOOP) and the row is Loop Terminal; the next row of the country, Grand Isle, is another place.

los-angeles-long-beach.why: the file has one row for each of the two harbours, Los Angeles and Long Beach, with different channel depths; a single entry would show the figures of one of them for a port that counts both

pivdennyi.name: Yuzhnyy
pivdennyi.why: Atlas point 46.63 N, 31.02 E, row no. 43655 Yuzhnyy at 46.60 N, 31.02 E. Yuzhnyy is the Russian spelling of the Ukrainian Pivdennyi (the atlas note gives the PortWatch code UAYUZ for the port); the next row of the country, Odesa, is another port.

rosario-up-river.why: the atlas port is the up-river hub of several terminals (its note) and the row is the port of the city of Rosario

ruwais.name: Jabal Az Zannah/ruways
ruwais.why: Atlas point 24.13 N, 52.71 E, row no. 48282 Jabal Az Zannah/ruways at 24.20 N, 52.70 E. The atlas note says the PortWatch database lists the port as Jabal Az Zannah-Ruways, and the row carries the same two names (alternate name Jabal Dhanna/ruways); the next row of the country, Mubarraz Oil Terminal, is another port.
